title: Parade scheme - Vanguard standard bearer (Mk2)
summary: The same scheme retargeted to the remastered sculpt, whose separate banner is painted off the model.

target.description: Example Miniatures Vanguard standard bearer, Mk2 remaster - 32mm plastic, banner supplied as a separate component

steps.title: Banner, off the model
steps.instruction: Paint the separate banner flat on the sprue in Warm Bone before assembly - the folds are unreachable once it is glued.

steps.title: Armour plates
steps.instruction: Basecoat the recut armour plates with two thin coats of Deep Navy.

steps.title: Trim
steps.instruction: Edge the deeper Mk2 trim with Old Gold; the original sculpt's shallower bevel does not need the second pass.

org.brushcodex.subject:identity.qualifier: Mk2 remaster; the banner is a separate component and the armour trim is recut deeper, so both the painting order and the edge pass change

org.brushcodex.product:sourceContext.note: Same designation as the original sculpt, different geometry, and therefore a different subject identity.
